title: Deleting a Part Library entry that a part now uses is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a Part Library entry with no part behind it for this test, entry A: create a part at the test location, then delete it, so the entry stays with "Total parts" 0.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, type entry A's part number in the Search box.
  2. In tab 1, click the entry A row.
  3. In tab 1, click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address.
  5. In tab 2, click Parts in the top bar.
  6. In tab 2, click Inventory in the left menu.
  7. In tab 2, click New Inventory Part.
  8. In tab 2, type entry A's description in Description.
  9. In tab 2, type entry A's part number in Part Number, exactly as the entry has it.
  10. In tab 2, pick any category in Category.
  11. In tab 2, type 10.00 in Cost.
  12. In tab 2, click Save.
  13. Switch back to tab 1 without reloading it.
  14. In tab 1, click Delete.
  15. In tab 1, confirm the deletion.
  16. Wait 5 seconds.
  17. In tab 1, click Parts in the top bar.
  18. In tab 1, click Part Library in the left menu.
  19. In tab 1, type entry A's part number in the Search box.
  20. In tab 1, click the entry A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Entry A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Its detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 0.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens and its Delete button, bottom left, is enabled, because no part uses the entry yet.

Step 4:

  • A second tab opens.

Step 5:

  • Tab 2 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 6:

  • Tab 2 shows the Inventory page.

Step 7:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens in tab 2.

Step 8:

  • Description shows entry A's description.

Step 9:

  • Part Number shows entry A's number.

Step 10:

  • Category shows the category you picked.

Step 11:

  • Cost shows 10.00.

Step 12:

  • The window closes in tab 2 and the part is saved.

Step 13:

  • Tab 1 still shows the Edit Library Part window: it was not reloaded.

Step 14:

  • The confirmation asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"

Step 15:

  • The delete is refused: a red message reads "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."

Step 16:

  • The red message has closed on its own after about 3 seconds.

Step 17:

  • Tab 1 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 18:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 19:

  • Entry A is still listed.

Step 20:

  • Its detail page shows "Total parts" 1: the part saved in tab 2 uses it.
